summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the Team composition flow in /staff-volontari → Team tab, per iteration_50 request. All 11 acceptance items VERIFIED (10 green out of the box; 1 bug found during testing and fixed with a one-line prop wiring change in Persons.jsx). Flows covered: (1) 'Vedi componenti' lists Staff + Volontari with Tipo column, ordered Cognome→Nome A-Z (observed: Bianchi Anna/Staff, Rossi Marco/Staff, Verdi Luca/Volontario). (2) No empty '—' name rows anywhere (hasName() filter active). (3) 'Aggiungi componente' popover shows candidates Staff+Volontari of the event not yet in team, with Tipo badge (observed 'Viola Giulia / Volontario'), ordered Cognome→Nome; team-add-search filters correctly. (4) team-add-new-person is in the footer and stays visible after scrolling the candidates list. (5) Selecting an existing candidate fires PUT /api/staff/{id} 200 and team-count-total goes 3→4 without page reload. (6) Quick-create form has all testids (tp-nome, tp-cognome, tp-cellulare with intl selector, tp-email, tp-tipo, tp-save); creating a Volontario fires POST /api/staff/quick-add 200 (status='ok'), popover closes while the Team dialog stays open, and the new member appears in the list with Tipo=Volontario — count updates in place. (7) Dedup: posting with the same email returns {status:'exists'}; the yellow 'Esiste già un'anagrafica…' box appears with tp-use-existing. (8) team-member-remove-<id> fires PUT /api/staff/{id} with team_id='' (200) and count decrements. (9) Opening a member by clicking the name (team-member-open-<id>) opens the Person dialog. (10) Team Leader field (field-responsabile_id) in Aggiungi Team shows ONLY Staff of the selected event (observed: Anna Bianchi, Elena Blu, Davide Mora, Sara Neri, Marco Rossi) — NO Volontari (Verdi Luca, Paolo Gialli, Giulia Viola correctly excluded).

integration_issues.flow: TeamMembersDialog → quick-create new person (resolved during this iteration)
integration_issues.issue: Newly created person via POST /api/staff/quick-add did NOT appear in the Team members list and team-count-total did not increment, even though the API returned 200. Root cause: Persons.jsx passed onReloadStaff={reloadStaff} to TeamMembersDialog, which only refreshes /staff links but not /persons-enriched. The members useMemo looks up each pid via persons.find(x=>x.id===pid); when the newly created person is absent from rows, the record becomes {} and is filtered out by hasName(). Fix applied: Persons.jsx line 413 now passes onReloadStaff={reloadTeamData} (which already reloads both /staff and /persons-enriched). Re-tested green: creating 'RetestFirst QaRetest' (Volontario) made the row appear with Tipo=Volontario and count 5→6 without reload; removal brought it back to 5.

action_items: Review and keep the one-line fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/Persons.jsx line 413 (onReloadStaff={reloadTeamData}). It is strictly necessary — without it, the quick-add Volontario/Staff from the Team dialog succeeds server-side but the user sees no change until manual reload.
critical_code_review_comments: TeamMembersDialog.members correctly uses hasName() to exclude anagrafiche without nominativo and dedups by persona_id — this prevents the '— Staff' phantom rows mentioned in the problem statement.

candidates useMemo correctly filters by evento_id, categories staff/collaboratore/volontario, excludes already-in-team persons, applies case-insensitive Cognome→Nome locale sort, and keeps '+ Aggiungi nuova persona' outside the scrollable list so it stays reachable.

StaffAssignSelect for Team Leader is wired via type='staffselect' with staffPersonsFor:(form)=>staffPersonsForEvent(form?.evento_id); staffByEvent is computed from staffLinks with categoria∈{staff,collaboratore} — Volontari are correctly excluded.
Minor finding (fixed): the Team dialog's onReloadStaff callback should refresh persons too, not only staff, since quick-add can create a new Person. Changed to reloadTeamData.

Suggestion (not fixed): consider also calling reloadTeamData after addMember/removeMember in TeamMembersDialog so that if staffLinks were created server-side for other reasons the UI stays in sync (currently only onReloadStaff is called, which now covers both).

rca of the issue: When the user quick-created a new person from the TeamMembersDialog, POST /api/staff/quick-add correctly created the Person + Staff link with team_id and returned 200. The dialog then called onReloadStaff which was wired to reloadStaff (only /staff). The parent Persons.jsx had the fresh staffLinks (with the new link.persona_id and team_id), but its 'rows' (persons from /persons-enriched) still didn't contain the new person. The TeamMembersDialog's members useMemo does persons.find(x=>x.id===pid)||{} which returned {}, so nome/cognome/email were empty, hasName() returned false, and the row was filtered out — making it appear as if nothing happened. Fix: wire onReloadStaff to reloadTeamData which parallel-reloads both /staff and /persons-enriched. Verified end-to-end: new 'RetestFirst QaRetest' (Volontario) appeared with correct Tipo badge, team-count-total went 5→6, no page reload. Reproduction before the fix: in Persons.jsx revert line 413 to onReloadStaff={reloadStaff}, create a new Volontario from TeamMembersDialog → observe toast success but no row and count unchanged until manual reload.
